domain:ui#2 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRFuJz9QBZqPVHYVhJ

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：权限矩阵横向滚动时，展开对象下方的字段面板（筛选、计数、批量按钮、字段表）固定在单元格缩进处，宽度不超过可见区域；字段名列不再单独固定。Studio 权限页和元数据管理页同时生效。QA 清单对应条目加一条验收。
- **为什么改**：矩阵最小宽度 1304 px，窄窗格要横向滚动。原先固定在左侧的字段名列约 697 px 宽，滚过约 80 px 就盖住每个字段的"读/写"勾选框，窗格窄于 1304 px 时根本点不到。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只改一个组件的样式类（约 28 行源码）；窗格放得下整张矩阵时外观不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` 的 `FIELD_PANEL` 与 `MATRIX_PANE`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.fieldTableLayout-26846.test.tsx`，预期全绿；浏览器几何测试 `ui/e2e/permission-field-panel-scroll.spec.ts` 由必跑的 Build & E2E UI 执行。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位验收后进合并队列。

**席位意见：** 实测 main 上 1000 px 窗格滚到 80 px 时 18 个勾选框只有 9 个可点，200 px 起全部被盖；修复后每个偏移都 18/18。只固定名字宽度不够（任何滚动仍会把框滑到名字下），所以改为固定整个字段面板。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:ui#2` · head `9d196c52` · 2026-11-03T03:27Z

- **形态:** draft PR on `main`, `Fixes #29677` on its own line. 6 files, +541/−33 (source +28/−11), Tier S (`check-governed-merges --pr 29744`: not governed; under 3000 lines). All inside claim 6593552174: `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` (the two scroll panes and the field panel; the panel's root div replaces the pinned name cell, seat-accepted at design), the QA item `studio-authoring.permission-matrix-editor-ux` (rev 10, acceptance[6], step B5, negative[2], an appended history row), tests, the changeset. #29718's hunks in the same file do not meet these.
- **前提实测:** on `main` (admin, 1000 px pane) `elementFromPoint` reaches 9 of 18 field boxes at scrollLeft 80 and 0 of 18 from 200; the Studio pane at 760 px never reaches all. On this head: 18 of 18 at every offset on both renderings. The seat looked at the before/after shots in `/mnt/project-files/issue-29677/screens/`.
- **门禁 check-runs (pinned to head `9d196c52fc9c5bb58cefbc1521e0d8d4df0dc84b`):** 48 success, 9 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending (57 runs), including `Check Changeset`, `Type Check UI`, `Lint UI`, `Test UI` (16 shards) and `Build & E2E UI` (which runs the new geometry spec). Dev local gates: 42 derived, 42 run, all exit 0, 0 NOT-MEASURED; post-merge `check-sdui-manifest`, platform-checklist, `check-changeset-no-major` and NUL-byte checks exit 0. The new Playwright spec runs under the default config in the required `Build & E2E UI` (`--project=chromium`), 6 of 6; the jsdom class-contract pins on both renderings, 4 files / 26 tests; neighbours 52 files / 368. Ablation with `main`'s editor: the spec reds at scrollLeft 80 (`covered by perm-field-name`) while its CONTROL stays green; jsdom 4 of 12 red.
- **Code read:** the pane becomes a size container (`@container`) and the panel is `sticky left-12` with `max-w-[calc(100cqi-6rem)]`, the expanded cell's own `pl-12` inset on both hosts, so the four-column field table never scrolls with the object columns. Where the pane holds the whole matrix nothing moves.
- **接受的偏差:** the whole field panel is pinned instead of the name cell only (bounding the name alone still slides the boxes under it on any scroll); a browser geometry spec plus jsdom class pins, since jsdom has no layout.
- **范围外去向:** on an expanded or hovered object row in Studio, scrolled object boxes show faintly through the pinned Object cell (its tint is not opaque); the same on `main`, cosmetic, no lost control, so recorded here, not filed. No `Skills-docs:` line is owed.
- **落地条款:** `Clause-②: no` (app-shell is private), `Metadata-protocol: none`, `patch` for `@object-ui/app-shell`; no contract review is owed. Land by `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`.
